study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain morphology normative modelling platform for abnormality and centile estimation: Brain MoNoCle

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used healthy control data from 21 sites/batches: ADHD1000 (Oregon ADHD-1000, n=153), BLISS (n=26), CamCAN s1 (n=495) and s2 (n=83), Chronotype (n=126), Greene-HM (n=22), HCP (n=678), MEGUK Aston1 (n=29), Aston2 (n=69), Cambridge (n=71), Glasgow (n=24), Oxford (n=63), NCL-dementia s1 (n=29) and s2 (n=26), NIMH-IHV s1 (n=48) and s2 (n=54), NKI (n=790), OASIS3 (n=355), Stanford-CR (n=40), UCLH s1 (n=28) and s3 (n=67). Total n=3,276. The listed recognized datasets from the guide are Cam-CAN, HCP, NKI, OASIS-3, and BLISS. The remaining datasets (ADHD1000/Oregon ADHD-1000, Chronotype, Greene-HM, MEGUK, NCL-dementia, NIMH-IHV, Stanford-CR, UCLH) are in-house or not in the standard list. Given 21 sites, MULTI-SITE (N>=2) is applicable.

Table S1.1 lists: ADHD1000 (n=153), BLISS (n=26), CamCAN s1 (n=495), CamCAN s2 (n=83), Chronotype (n=126), Greene-HM (n=22), HCP (n=678), MEGUK Aston1 (n=29), MEGUK Aston2 (n=69), MEGUK Cambridge (n=71), MEGUK Glasgow (n=24), MEGUK Oxford (n=63), NCL-dementia s1 (n=29), NCL-dementia s2 (n=26), NIMH-IHV s1 (n=48), NIMH-IHV s2 (n=54), NKI (n=790), OASIS3 (n=355), Stanford-CR (n=40), UCLH s1 (n=28), UCLH s3 (n=67), Total=3,276

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All 21 sites/datasets listed in Table S1.1 were used to pre-train normative models. The IDEAS dataset (133 mTLE + 99 HC) and BLISS dataset (56 BD + 26 HC) were used as exemplar clinical datasets to validate the normative models. The HC portion of BLISS (n=26) is included in normative training. The study does not separate train/validation/test splits within the normative cohort.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "To pre-train normative models, we used data from 3,276 healthy individuals from several large public and in-house datasets" ... "To demonstrate the utility of our normative models in predicting abnormalities in patient groups and individuals, we included two exemplar clinical datasets. A sample of 133 adults with mesial TLE (mTLE; n = 74 right hemisphere seizure onset; n = 59 left hemisphere seizure onset) and 99 healthy controls (HC-mTLE) were acquired from the recent IDEAS dataset release ... We also included a sample of 56 adults with bipolar disorder (BD) and 26 healthy controls (HC-BD) from the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)"

model-1.model-name: Brain MoNoCle normative model (multiple metrics: cortical thickness, volume, surface area, K, I, S)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study built a single normative modelling platform with models for multiple brain morphology metrics (cortical thickness, cortical volume, pial surface area, and independent components K, I, S). All models used the same 3,276 healthy controls from 21 sites. The study does not explicitly report a train/validation/test split within the normative cohort; subsampling analysis showed model stability at n~2000.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The supplementary Table S1.1 reports median and range for each site and for the total sample (median=33, range 5-95 years). Mean and SD are not directly reported for the total sample. Individual site data provides median and range only, making calculation of weighted mean and pooled SD not feasible without original data. No train/test split statistics are reported.
